title: Today view
lead: Replace the landing page at `/` (S62) with tonight's dinner, mark it made, and a link to the list (P1, P3, U2).
boundary: **Not in this slice:** notifications; pantry nudges; the week view (S60); the PWA manifest, whose `start_url` is already `/` (S08).

sections.heading: Why
sections.body: This is the screen everyday users actually use. It must be readable at a glance and need one tap at most. S62 serves a placeholder at `/` for paired devices; this slice replaces its body and keeps the URL and the `home.index` endpoint.

sections.heading: Owner input
sections.body: None. Owner decisions: 2026-11-04 (ADR 0013 Rules, S19): a skipped meal rolls to the next open night, so the Today view's skip control moves the meal there. 2026-11-05, answered by the owner: (1) the view shows tonight's dinner only, with a 'view recipe' link to the read-only recipe page (S14); tomorrow's dinner and a defrost hint are not built; (2) the buttons read 'Made it' and 'Skip tonight'.

sections.heading: Files
sections.body:
- `src/larder/web/home_views.py` and `src/larder/web/templates/home.html` (from S62; replace the body, keep the route)
- `src/larder/planner_db.py` (extend S62's `meal_on`)
- `tests/test_today.py` (replaces the placeholder checks in `tests/test_home.py`)

sections.heading: Implement
sections.body:
1. Query today's planned meal; render the title, a link to the recipe view (S14) and the made/skip buttons.
2. "Made" records history (used by recency); "skip" applies the ADR 0013 rule.
3. Add a link or button to the shopping list.
4. Do not edit the manifest; `start_url` is `/` already.

sections.heading: Check
sections.body: - Tests pass; a non-technical household member can use it unassisted in a hallway test (the owner observes).

sections.heading: Git
sections.body: Add the Today view with made and skip controls (S22).
